issues.description: Screen is stuck in loading state - never transitions to the actual render result screen with AI-redesigned room image and before/after slider. The loading animation appears frozen on step 1 ('Analyzing your space...').
issues.root_cause: The step-8a page likely has a loading simulation that either never completes, or the condition to transition from loading to result state is broken. The simulated loading steps probably use setTimeout/setInterval that either never resolves or the state transition to 'complete' never fires, keeping isLoading true indefinitely. Alternatively, the render result fetch/mock returns no data causing it to stay in loading state.

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors across multiple pages (step-3, step-3b, step-7c, step-8a) - 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML'. This causes the entire root to switch to client rendering.
issues.root_cause: Dynamic content (timestamps, random values, or browser-only APIs like localStorage/sessionStorage) is being rendered during SSR and produces different output on the client. Likely in page components that read from localStorage or use Math.random()/Date during render without suppressing hydration or using useEffect.

fixes.reason: Placeholder to identify the state variables - actual fix below targets the loading completion logic

The interval completes all 4 loading steps but never calls setIsLoading(false), so the screen stays stuck in loading state forever. Adding setIsLoading(false) in the else branch transitions to the result screen.
